task: D3 packed fused public trainer qualification
resident_reference_definition: Resident means all routed-expert weights resident. Native and staged references reconstruct identical prepared bytes using their declared B1/native or staged path; the fused reference retains the original packed bytes/statistics and uses the same fused kernel and row policy as streaming. Non-expert layers retain the same public streaming setup. These are correctness-only references, not full-resident-model timing runs.
reference: Independent native-resident ordinary GA oracle for each codec, plus same-kernel resident/streamed staged and fused pairs.

data.kind: synthetic token IDs/targets through all sixteen pretrained OLMoE layers
data.input_range: CPU torch.Generator seed 1729; randint(3, config.vocab_size), shape 7x512
data.labels: copy input IDs; labels[:,0]=-100 and every eleventh position=-100
data.row_order: Public Trainer sampler seed 29. Retain and compare actual delivered row/token/label hashes per accumulation window.
data.label_denominator: Exact number of nonignored shifted next-token labels in each actual accumulation window, including the one-row final window.

adapter_initialization: Prepare and pin complete attention LoRA initial factors before freeze. Load matching values after each Trainer setup, preserving the actual TRL QLoRA BF16 adapter dtype for both NF4 codecs. Save dtype/shape/raw bytes and initial state hashes.

numerics.autocast: Explicit CUDA BF16, including all matching save/reload evaluation paths
numerics.evaluation_output: FP32 logits on both prepared-Trainer and restored-Trainer paths
numerics.attention_implementation: Record and require identical native implementation across all cells; no attention/CE/kernel patch may differ between arms.

numerical_gates.forward: Exact logits/loss/routing and expert outputs, separately stated.
numerical_gates.backward: Exact input/router gradients in every trained decoder layer and every trainable attention-LoRA parameter; finite values, nonzero effective gradients.
numerical_gates.adapter_updates: Exact complete adapter state after every real optimizer step; prove a nonzero change from initial state.
numerical_gates.A_A: Reset initial parameters, optimizer, sampler and CPU/CUDA RNG; two same-process runs reproduce every step, gradients and updates exactly.
numerical_gates.negative: In the same process, add +0.5 to column 0 of the lexicographically first v_proj lora_B before a reset replay. Logits and at least one nonzero gradient must differ; an ineffective control gives no verdict, not a larger perturbation or relaxed threshold.
numerical_gates.restored: Restore the exact initial factors, optimizer and RNG after the fixed negative control; replay must match the original exactly.
numerical_gates.save_reload: Save through wrapper.train(), construct the same public Trainer/dtype recipe, load the saved adapter; factors/dtypes/logits must match exactly. Repeat for ordinary SFT and L2L.
numerical_gates.same_kernel_resident_streamed: native/sequential, grouped-resident/grouped, packed fused-resident/fused with identical respective packed bytes, kernel and row policy.

streaming.resident_oracles: Separate correctness-only processes; never left resident during streamed memory/timing arms.
streaming.dispatch: staged: native 1..128 and 481..512; fused: native 1..128, WMMA 129..512; empty experts skipped. Distinct profiles are explicit; timing estimates the complete backend change, not fusion alone.

packed_backend.meaning: staged versus packed hybrid including declared row-policy difference, restore/load/gather/scatter and public optimizer window

timing_definition: Public optimizer windows 2/2/2/1; omit step zero; measure steps 1,2,3. Stop wall/CUDA windows before copying audit gradients; resume for optimizer work. Hashes, final evaluation and cleanup outside timing. Profiles are separate arms.
repeat_rule: For each codec/training stratum, use complete four-arm grouped/fused/fused/grouped ABBA blocks for the single packed-backend contrast. Reuse unchanged arm_validity.repeats: sigma=sqrt((var(A)+var(B))/2), delta=0.10*mean(A), N=max(2,ceil(7.85*(sigma/delta)^2)). First target=max(5,N) from five pilot blocks. At that target recompute N once from that prefix; final target=max(first,N). No later top-up. If target exceeds ten, retain records and report no-verdict precision budget; never discard/replace a void block.
profiles: Separate staged/fused CUDA profiles per codec and ordinary/L2L; actual CUPTI compute kernels, route counts and allocator peaks. Require positive fused work, including an executed fused WMMA kernel. Native fallback counted separately.
memory: Separate training allocated/reserved peaks after warmup/reset, before evaluation/reload; synchronize. Record whole-child peak RSS and pinned/staging/arena budgets separately. F1 retains sampled GPU clocks/event reasons and before/after box stamps including GPU used-memory, RAM availability, commit charge and power-source readings; these endpoints are not telemetry peaks. This launcher does not record per-cell temperature/power-draw CSV endpoints. No activation-only or optimizer-only result is called total-VRAM reduction.
budget_enforcement: One session per committed source, zero replacements, 1200-second child and 129600-second whole-session cap; at most 192 children. Preserve incomplete cells; stop on first failure/no verdict.
validity: Reuse unchanged arm_validity.ArmWatch and empirical sysfs/guest mapping. Before freeze verify all prepared shard hashes and paths, baseline OK, complete aligned own-shard reads OK and an independent foreign O_DIRECT reader VOID. Actual trained-shard controls are bound separately from synthetic-fixture controls in preparation receipts. Require per-cell F1 OK, unchanged boot/data/source identities and the sole exposed CUDA workload. Missing required validity sensors, unknown/void F1, visible foreign workloads, restart or identity changes stop the series with no verdict. GPU clock telemetry retains its own OK/unknown status; physical host/cache isolation remains uncertified.
decision: Report exactness and observed staged/packed-hybrid time, memory and actual launches separately; no positive speedup, whole-VRAM reduction, convergence or final task acceptance is assumed.
promotion: Prepare inputs and actual-shard controls, execute the pinned four-layer untied synthetic parent/child launcher, pass offline replay and fault tests; bind receipts and commit before canonical export/formal execution.
retention: Preserve all historical studies and failed/incomplete formal sessions and all preliminary trainer preflight failures. Keep raw tensors/native oracle, state/route/gradient hashes, logs, F1 records, profiles, source packet, manifests and offline byte-identical analysis. Verify publication from normalized committed bytes in a fresh checkout.

limitations: Synthetic IDs and four SGD steps do not establish quality or convergence.
Frozen experts plus attention LoRA; no routed-expert LoRA, nonzero router auxiliary loss, second derivatives or full-weight fine-tuning.
Ordinary/L2L results are specific to this source, GPU and recipe; A3 Mistral noise-floor/tolerance criteria do not relax D3 byte exactness.

The comparator performs staged grouped restoration/GEMM. The candidate is a hybrid: packed fused WMMA for rows 129..512 and counted native restoration/GEMM for rows 1..128. Their high-row dispatch policies differ; timing estimates the complete backend change, not fusion alone.
Separate owner/reviewer full-task acceptance is still required.
activation_scope: Native SiLU and multiply in both arms. No custom activation kernel in this study.
